messages:
Zoe (Content): Hi team 1 draft for the launch post is in the doc: https://docs.google/draft. Need quick passes on: hero headline variants, benchmark framing (embeddings vs autoregressive baselines), webinar panelists list, CTAs, and exact HubSpot form -> routing mapping. Want to lock before lunch.

Julian (Product): Read and left comments. Avoid absolute uplift numbers in the hero; use 'up to' with a pointer to the benchmark appendix. Added a tech blurb about mixed-precision quantization benefits.

Miles (Growth): Adding UTMs and GA4 events. Proposal: primary CTA -> webinar RSVP, secondary -> request demo. UTM sample: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026&utm_medium=content`. Also propose analytics event `blog_launch_cta` with property `cta_variant`.

Nora (Design): Hero options uploaded: hero_speed.png, hero_value.png. Will export mobile crops after copy locks. Need final hero text to create accessible alt text.

Clare (Sales Ops): For routing, recommend fields: company_size, company_revenue_bracket, use_case (evaluation|pilot|production). Map company_size>1000 -> AE queue, 50-1000 -> SDR queue, <50 -> Growth SDR. What exact tag strings do you want in HubSpot?

Raj (Engineering): Quick quote for hero: "We focused on predictable tail latency and efficient KV cache reuse to improve responsiveness at scale." Shortened version is in the doc. Also added a link to the infra appendix for benchmarking details.

LegalBot: Auto-scan result: phrase 'industry-leading' flagged. Please remove or provide substantiation. Also customer name placeholder needs signed consent before publish.

Zoe (Content): Swapped 'industry-leading' for 'production-grade' and left customer placeholder as 'Early Access Partner' pending sign-off.

Miles (Growth): For the webinar RSVP flow: proposing prefill fields: name, email, company, role, interest_area. Use `interest_area` to pre-tag registrants (embeddings|generation|ops). That helps Sales Ops triage leads.

Clare (Sales Ops): Confirming tag strings: `lead_tier=enterprise|midmarket|smb`, `interest_area=embeddings|generation|ops`, `source=blog_launch`. I'll wire these into HubSpot once forms are final.

Nora (Design): Uploaded final hero assets and thumbnails to the assets folder. Left alt text suggestions inline.

Julian (Product): Updated benchmark wording to: 'up to 3x lower latency in cache-hot workloads; see appendix for test config.' That should satisfy engineering and docs.

Miles (Growth): Tweaked RSVP button text to 'Save your seat' (A) vs 'Join live' (B). Leaning to A. Also added email reminder cadence: confirmation, 24h reminder, 1h reminder.

Clare (Sales Ops): Routing rules staged. I'll monitor first 100 leads and report anomalies. Also set a Slack alert to #sales-inbound when enterprise leads arrive.

LegalBot: Customer placeholder cleared for publish with 'Early Access Partner' language; replace with real name only after consent. All flagged claims addressed.

Zoe (Content): Locking copy at 11:45 PT. Pushing to staging for preview. SchedulerBot, can you reserve the publish slot we discussed?

SchedulerBot: Publish window reserved for 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC.

Miles (Growth): I'll A/B hero variants Speed vs Value for the first 24h and report CTR + signup delta.

Clare (Sales Ops): Routing pushed to staging. Monitoring live and will post a quick readout after the first hour of leads.

Zoe (Content): Thanks all 1 final checklist: hero text locked, benchmarks hedged and linked, CTO quote in place, assets uploaded, UTMs and routing strings confirmed. Pushing to staging now.
